Priya Rao: Planning maintenance for az4 GPU pool (az4-gpu-main, ~50 GPUs) next Thu 01:45-03:00 UTC. NIC microcode + staggered reboots.
Ben Holt: Will this be soft drains or full evacuations?
Priya Rao: Soft drains only. We'll cordon and drain in 3-node cohorts to keep tail latency bounded.
SRE-Alex: Recommend cohorts every 6m, run nvlink crc check and quick 50-sample inference smoke test on canary nodes before each cohort.
Ben Holt: What's our fallback routing? We should cap cross-az failover to 15% to avoid egress spikes.
Priya Rao: Agreed. Also pre-seed KV cache on backfill nodes 20m prior to window.
SRE-Alex: Oncall please: infra-bot?
infra-bot: Scheduled oncall: Primary - SRE-Alex, Backup - Ben Holt for 2026-03-26 01:45 UTC window.
Ben Holt: Capacity sim please. If queued >200 units we escalate to two-region fallback.
Priya Rao: Running sim now... result: peak queued 158 units, projected GPU util 86% during cohort 5. Safe without region failover.
SRE-Alex: Add grep checks: `journalctl -u nvlink | grep -i error` and `dmesg | grep -E "PCIe|MCE"` after reboot.
Priya Rao: Draft tenant comms: "Maintenance Wed 01:45-03:00 UTC in az4. Expect brief capacity reductions; some requests may route or queue. Reply with tenant id if you need reserved capacity." Posting 24h notice now.
